text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Exercise-Induced Bronchoconstriction (EIB) with chronic airway hyperresponsiveness.

The negative methacholine challenge and normal imaging suggest your symptoms are driven by specific triggers like cold air and exercise rather than fixed structural disease or classic atopic asthma. I recommend a trial of a rescue inhaler before your next exposure to cold air to confirm if this resolves your symptoms.
